instructions: Achieve neutral buoyancy and carefully move through the training module hatch. Maintain your orientation and avoid contact with the hatch edges.
Navigate to the mock solar panel array and replace the damaged connection. Adjust your weight to maintain position while working.
Descend to the pool floor to collect the lunar rock sample. Add weight to descend, then remove it to ascend back to neutral.
Move horizontally across the pool floor while maintaining contact. This simulates walking on the lunar surface in bulky EVA suits.
Quickly adjust your buoyancy to retrieve the floating tool, then return to neutral position. Time is critical in this emergency simulation.
Connect two training modules while maintaining perfect neutral buoyancy. Any drift will cause connection failure.
